item.title: Downtown condo project proposed near Channing House
item.description: In the latest sign of downtown Palo Alto’s housing resurgence, a downtown property owner has just proposed building a six-story condominium building with 60 units across the street from Channing House. The post Downtown condo project proposed near Channing House appeared first on Palo Alto Online.

item.title: Santa Clara County tackles $470M budget shortfall
item.description: Santa Clara County leaders are looking at a $470 million deficit in the upcoming fiscal year — forcing the largest midyear budget adjustment in more than a decade as they look to close $200 million of the gap. The post Santa Clara County tackles $470M budget shortfall appeared first on Palo Alto Online.

item.title: At SLAC, advanced X-ray tech uncovers long-lost star map
item.description: At SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory in Menlo Park, scientists from across the globe are using advanced X-rays to find a long-lost map of the galaxy by ancient Greek astronomer Hipparchus. The post At SLAC, advanced X-ray tech uncovers long-lost star map appeared first on Palo Alto Online.

item.title: Palo Alto looks to brighten up downtown with mural program
item.description: Downtown Palo Alto will soon get an infusion of color and whimsy thanks to a new city program to commission murals for prominent buildings in the area. The first of these is set to go up at All-Saints Episcopal Church at 555 Waverley St. The post Palo Alto looks to brighten up downtown with mural program appeared first on Palo Alto Online.

item.title: Stanford vandalism case ends in mistrial after ‘hopelessly deadlocked’ jury
item.description: A Santa Clara County judge declared a mistrial Friday in the felony vandalism case of five Stanford University students who had barricaded themselves in the president’s office during a spring 2024 protest in support of Palestine, after he found the jury to be “hopelessly deadlocked.” The post Stanford vandalism case ends in mistrial after ‘hopelessly deadlocked’ jury appeared first on Palo Alto Online.
